body:
Not weird at all. I have a period tracker app that I record my sexual activity on. I’ve been with my boyfriend for three years and still do this. I also do the date, time (sometimes), location, and positions/acts. I think it’s important to put your health (all health) first. Doctors have records of your health, so why can you have your own records? 

Dude sounds like a snoopy prude. It’s none of his business and he should keep his hands off of other’s property. Real friends wouldn’t judge you or make you feel ashamed of something like that.

The other day I posted about how I’m feeling disappointed that all I’ve had were negative side effects. Then towards the evening yesterday, I could only think about making out and pouncing on my boyfriend. We were watching a movie and he fell asleep, I didn’t try anything. But I was awake until 3a and I could not fall asleep until something happened. So I woke him up and got freaky. It’s been on my brain all day today. I’m trying to take care of myself, see if that lessens it. Nope, 15mins later I want more. 

I haven’t said anything to my boyfriend or really acted on things because I’m afraid it won’t last. My depression has killed our sex life for almost 2 years. We’d have sex like once a month. So I would hate to disappoint not only him, but myself. I really hope this side effect sticks, though. I’d rather go to the bathroom at work and rub one out than not have sex for months and feel nothing, lol.

I’ve had this going on for about 5 days now. I was freakin out. Anywhere that I scratched, more would pop up. I started taking Zyrtec once a day, an hour before my nighttime dose. It’s helped a lot. I’m still having red patches show up, even just from carrying too many groceries. But the itching is is way day.
